A selection of academic and personal projects spanning business strategy, product development, and web design.

```{=html}
<div class="proj-filter-bar">
  <div class="proj-filter-group">
    <label class="proj-filter-label" for="proj-filter-type">Type</label>
    <select class="proj-filter-select" id="proj-filter-type">
      <option value="">All types</option>
      <option value="Academic">Academic</option>
      <option value="Personal">Personal</option>
    </select>
  </div>
  <div class="proj-filter-group">
    <label class="proj-filter-label" for="proj-filter-module">Module</label>
    <select class="proj-filter-select" id="proj-filter-module">
      <option value="">All modules</option>
      <option value="BAA1003">BAA1003 · New Enterprise Development</option>
      <option value="BAA1019">BAA1019 · Business Strategy</option>
      <option value="BAA1026">BAA1026 · Data Analytics</option>
      <option value="BAA1027">BAA1027 · Machine Learning</option>
      <option value="BAA1028">BAA1028 · Workflow &amp; Data Management</option>
      <option value="SB104">SB104 · Big Enterprise</option>
      <option value="SB202">SB202 · Critical Thinking</option>
    </select>
  </div>
  <button class="proj-filter-reset" id="proj-filter-reset" type="button">Reset</button>
</div>
<p class="proj-filter-empty" id="proj-filter-empty" style="display:none;">No projects match the selected filters.</p>

<script>
(function () {
  document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
    var list    = window['quarto-listings'] && window['quarto-listings']['listing-listing'];
    var typeEl  = document.getElementById('proj-filter-type');
    var modEl   = document.getElementById('proj-filter-module');
    var resetEl = document.getElementById('proj-filter-reset');
    var emptyEl = document.getElementById('proj-filter-empty');

    if (!list || !typeEl) return;

    function applyFilters() {
      var type    = typeEl.value;
      var mod     = modEl.value;
      var visible = 0;

      if (!type && !mod) {
        list.filter();
        emptyEl.style.display = 'none';
        return;
      }

      list.filter(function (item) {
        var raw  = item.elm.getAttribute('data-categories') || '';
        var cats = decodeURIComponent(atob(raw)).split(',');
        var show = true;
        if (type && !cats.includes(type)) show = false;
        if (mod  && !cats.includes(mod))  show = false;
        if (show) visible++;
        return show;
      });

      emptyEl.style.display = visible === 0 ? '' : 'none';
    }

    typeEl.addEventListener('change', applyFilters);
    modEl.addEventListener('change', applyFilters);
    resetEl.addEventListener('click', function () {
      typeEl.value = '';
      modEl.value  = '';
      applyFilters();
    });
  });
})();
</script>
```
